test.create_query: CREATE TABLE vmd_mt_src (k UInt64, d DateTime, v1 UInt64, v2 UInt64, v3 UInt64, v4 UInt64, v5 UInt64, v6 UInt64, v7 UInt64, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE vmd_mt AS vmd_mt_src ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1

CREATE TABLE vmd_replacing_src AS vmd_mt_src ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE vmd_replacing AS vmd_mt_src ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1

CREATE TABLE vmd_ttl_src AS vmd_mt_src ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k TTL d + INTERVAL 1 DAY SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, max_number_of_merges_with_ttl_in_pool = 0

CREATE TABLE vmd_ttl AS vmd_mt_src ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k TTL d + INTERVAL 1 DAY SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, max_number_of_merges_with_ttl_in_pool = 0, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_columns_to_activate = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO vmd_mt_src SELECT cityHash64(number, 1), if(number % 10 < 3, now() - INTERVAL 2 DAY, now() + INTERVAL 10 YEAR), number, number * 3, number * 7, cityHash64(number, 2), cityHash64(number, 3), cityHash64(number, 4), cityHash64(number, 5), toString(number % 1000), toString(cityHash64(number, 6) % 100000), concat('s', toString(number % 77)) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 100000, max_insert_block_size = 100000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO vmd_replacing_src SELECT * FROM vmd_mt_src SETTINGS max_block_size = 100000, max_insert_block_size = 100000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_threads = 1, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO vmd_ttl_src SELECT * FROM vmd_mt_src SETTINGS max_block_size = 100000, max_insert_block_size = 100000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_threads = 1, preferred_block_size_bytes = 0
DELETE FROM vmd_mt_src WHERE v1 % 10 = 5 SETTINGS lightweight_deletes_sync = 2
DELETE FROM vmd_replacing_src WHERE v1 % 10 = 5 SETTINGS lightweight_deletes_sync = 2
DELETE FROM vmd_ttl_src WHERE v1 % 10 = 5 SETTINGS lightweight_deletes_sync = 2
